title: Database resize or parallel capacity?
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare data-tier resize/failover paths; identify operations that are not online.
exactSourceAcceptance: Validate reconnects and transaction recovery; use parallel capacity if the operation exceeds interruption budgets.
exactParentAcceptance: Reconnects and transaction outcomes meet budgets where supported; disruptive native operations remain failed/unsupported, not assumed online.
preconditions: Standalone modern browser and local JavaScript; no database, account, service or credentials.
Four explicitly synthetic capability fixtures; no Azure product, SKU, region or online capability is inferred.
Three synthetic transactions per observed transition; preflight-blocked paths have zero started and three not run.
Parallel handoff needs a separately supported fixture and observed synchronized readiness.
actions: Choose the inspected path and capability, readiness, transaction and timing-evidence fixtures.
Set inclusive reconnect and transaction-recovery budgets in whole milliseconds, 0 through 5000.
Compare both paths under identical inputs; inspect measured timings, transaction accounting and the selected trace.
Retain up to six comparisons, including failure and unknown results; reset explicitly with keyboard support.
syntheticInputAndTrace: Fixed model.js fixtures: in-place 420/560 ms, parallel failover 180/320 ms, disruptive restart 2400/3100 ms. No native observation, random data, clock-dependent simulation or I/O.
expectedAssertions: Supported and ready synthetic paths pass only with timings inside both budgets and all three transactions recovered.
Restart-required resize remains FAILED / NOT ONLINE even with 5000 ms budgets.
Unsupported or unready parallel handoffs fail without fabricated transition observations.
Unqualified capabilities, unobserved readiness/timings and unresolved transactions cannot pass; known failures dominate unknowns.
Strict inputs, immutable validated state and a six-run guard retain earlier outcomes without alteration.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, reset, failure and CSP checks run with the pinned published browser helper.

bounds.history: Memory only; cleared by explicit reset or page reload.

iac.reason: Resource-free local lesson; recorded after loadable-stub assertion RED and before implementation.

testRuntime.lifecycle: openIsolatedLesson with awaited close in finally; abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified.

limits: Portable deterministic model only, not actual database resize, failover, reconnect or transaction recovery proof.
Native platform support, production Node.js 24, B-S063, D-S063 and five-nines qualification remain incomplete.
No real authentication, registration, identity, credentials, management calls or external effects.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, deployment, expenditure, package/framework install, download, unsafe flag or foreground lease.
Only learning/S063 is owned; no root/shared edits, extra units or worker-awarded acceptance.
